To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the wire ball open failures of MSPs under HTS conditions can be prevented by reducing the tensile stresses at gold wires.

the tensile stress was reduced by removing the PSR dam and by altering the loop shape from 45° angle to 90° angle, and that the tensile strength of the gold wire was increased by applying water soluble flux and adding cleaning processes.
the tensile stress induced in the wire by mechanical interaction between packages and solder flux residues reacting with encapsulant is the main cause of wire ball opens in the multi-stack package.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new failure mechanism of ball open in the MSP under HTS condition.
the reliability of a multi-stack-package (MSP) that consists of three different packages stacked.
the reliability of MSP under HTS condition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the wire ball open failure of a MSP under HTS condition is due to the Kirkendall void and tensile stress at wire.

the wire ball open failure of the gold wire at the interface of gold wire and bonding pads of the MSP under HTS condition of 150°C is accelerated by the tensil stress imposed at the wires due to the mechanical interaction between packages and the adhesion of encapsulant to the chip of bottom package.
the tensile stress caused by unstable warpage and the adherence between the top and bottom packages resulted in the ball open failure of the gold wire.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the warpage of packages and the tensile stress developed in the gold wires were critical factors for the ball open failure of MSPs.
the warpage of the packages should be minimized to avoid the unstable warpage, the PSR should not be in contact with the gold wire and the solder flux should be water soluble.
we successfully reduced the tensile stress by modifying the design and process, which resulted in the improvement of reliability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the warpage of the top and bottom packages should be considered when the packages are stacked.
it is necessary to consider the mechanical interaction between packages in the MSP to improve the HTS reliability.
the tensile stress induced at gold wires by the unstable warpage of stacked packages is a major cause of ball open failures under HTS condition.
